coaching.headline: We won zero fights and lost every major objective this game: Fangtooth three times, Genesis Core, Primal Fangtooth.
coaching.team: Three lanes were ours, but the team won none of six decisive fights. The first Fangtooth fell at 10 off an 0-3 teamfight; a 5v4 edge at 17 still lost 0-3. A solo jungle death at 28.8 triggered the collapse: Primal Fangtooth, two inner towers, and the inhibitor followed by 31.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Crunch's solo death at 28.8 came first: Primal Fangtooth, two inner towers, and the inhibitor all fell in the fights right after, with no fight won to stop it.
coaching.whatWorked: Scarlett led the team with 7 kills and 33,233 damage, won the offlane lane all game.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

skylar.loadout: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider), augment Plasma Barrage, crest Pacifier
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,509 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Skylar carry players this patch (32% of the team's). The damage came from Scattershot, Tainted Rounds, Lightning Hawk.
Atomiser at top rank: 85s base, about 77.3s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Spectra 10.
Skylar dealt 49,789 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +247 physical power from items.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.
Plasma Barrage (augment): Plasma Grenade reduces its own Cooldown by 3.5s when attaching to an Enemy Hero. On explosion, it also deals (+7.5% Target's Missing Health) Damage.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 1,870 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 6 effects on one trigger: Scattershot, Tainted Rounds, Lightning Hawk, Plasma Blade, Spectra, Weald.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Terminus, Pacifier.
The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Skylar killed built physical armor (Maco). Anti-heal on Drongo. We killed Skylar 2 times.
Copy it? Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider): 50.7% in 633 Skylar carry games, above the hero's 47.1%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

neon.loadout: Lotus (Flawless + Fragrance), augment RAM, crest Time-Flux Band

sources.note: random: 28 procs, 1 in 4 is +4 haste (expected value)
sources.how: 28 random bonuses (every 2 min and every takedown), 1 in 4 is +4 haste: about +28 expected

fedBy: Amulet Of Chaos (Deadly Wish): On Takedown: Reduce your current Basic Ability Cooldowns by 65%.• Restore 35% of your Missing Mana.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
RAM (augment): Gain 5 Magical Power and 25% Base Mana Regen on takedown, stacking infinitely. At 3 stacks gain 5% Movement Speed. Upon death, lost 50% of stacks rounded up.
ultPlus: Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 33 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Neon mid players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Neon touched shortened Final Thread, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 59s late); fight right after Final Thread is spent.
Final Thread at top rank: 95s base, about 59s by the end (38% shorter) from 61 ability haste: Timewarp 25, Time-Flux Band 8, Lotus 28.
12 takedowns (2 kills, 10 assists) fed: Amulet Of Chaos (Deadly Wish), Lotus (Eternal), RAM (augment).
Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
Neon dealt 30,748 hero damage, 20% of their team's, with +285 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Amulet Of Chaos 11; against Drongo (level 17 estimated: about 46 magical armor, 26 after penetration) and Renna (level 17 estimated: about 47 magical armor, 27 after penetration) that is about 16% and 16% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Fragrance (Eternal minor): Deal 4% increased Magical Damage and 12% increased True Damage to Enemy Heroes within 800 units.
Sustain: Flawless: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 8 (+10% Magical Power), once per cast.; 3,166 healing recorded.

Lesson: Neon's penetration cut through: Drongo took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 46, about 26 after 20 flat penetration).
Stack (Every takedown fed): 3 effects on one trigger: Amulet Of Chaos, Lotus, RAM. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Flawless. Neon has 4 damaging abilities (Erase Vector, L.I.N.X, Data Burst hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 61 ability haste brought them back 38% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Flawless + Fragrance) sits on the same triggers as the items (every takedown fed; every ability hit set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Neon killed built magical armor. We killed Neon 0 times.
Copy it? Lotus: 52.8% in 316 Neon midlane games, above the hero's 48.7%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Neon's takedowns fed Final Thread: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Final Thread is used.

amps.how: Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

amps.name: Pilow
amps.how: Decrease your size by 10%. Upon casting an ability, nearby enemy Heroes within 600 units are debuffed, dealing 4% decreased damage for 3.5s, stacking up to 3 times.

amps.name: Neurotoxin
amps.how: Pilow additionally increases damage enemies take by 1.5% per stack.

amps.name: Volcaic Slam
amps.how: Empowered Cindara leaves behind a rupture that erupts after 0.5s. The eruption deals 20 (+4 per Level) (+25%) Damage to Enemies and Slows by 40% for 1.25s.

effects.name: Terminus
effects.how: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.

effects.name: Solaris
effects.how: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.
